name: aquarion/bloom
description: A full screen social media platform built with Laravel, Inertia.js, and Tailwind CSS.
// ext-opentelemetry: Not a platform require: the extension is only present in prod (installed via install-php-extensions in the Dockerfile). open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-laravel's _register.php already guards on extension_loaded('opentelemetry') and no-ops otherwise, so requiring the extension here just blocks composer install on machines without it (dev/cloud sandboxes). The vendor package still hard-requires it transitively, so config.platform.ext-opentelemetry below fakes it present for dependency resolution too. Do not re-add the require or remove the platform override.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev" --names=server,queue,logs,vite --kill-others
scripts.// post-update-cmd: The fix-composer-dist-urls step rewrites composer.lock dist URLs from api.github.com to codeload.github.com so installs don't hit GitHub's rate-limited/auth-gated REST API - see bin/fix-composer-dist-urls.php for why. composer update regenerates those URLs back to api.github.com form, so this must run after every update to keep the lock file self-healing.
